newsitem.title: FRANCE: French mothers accused of selling children for sex.
newsitem.headline: French mothers accused of selling children for sex.

text.p: Two mothers were detained in Gradignan, southwestern France, on Friday on suspicion of renting out their children to paedophiles for sex, justice sources said.

Also held was a man in his seventies accused of having sex with children under 15 years of age and dealing in pornography related to child sexual abuse, and four other men suspected of complicity, the sources said.
Paramilitary gendarmes had been investigating the affair since March after receiving a tip that the elderly man had been seen in a wooded area in the company of a young girl.
According to the sources, the man paid the mothers 50 to 200 francs ($10 to $40) to photograph their children in sexual situations.
A total of 323 people, including teachers and clergy, have been placed under investigation in a highly publicised nationwide crackdown on paedophiles in France which began last week.
The crackdown targeted people whose names were found on the mailing list of a firm selling pornographic videos involving children.
Five of those investigated in the police raids have committed suicide.
